jobs.title: Entry Level Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Join Dell's AI/ML team in Austin to develop cutting-edge machine learning solutions. We're looking for recent graduates with strong Python and ML fundamentals. You'll work on real-world projects involving computer vision, NLP, and predictive analytics. Requirements: BS in CS/related field, Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, strong analytical skills.

jobs.title: Junior ML Engineer
jobs.description: Tesla Autopilot team is seeking entry-level ML engineers to work on autonomous driving. You'll contribute to developing neural networks for perception, prediction, and planning. Perfect for new grads passionate about AI and autonomous systems. Requirements: Strong Python, Deep Learning, Computer Vision experience, BS/MS in CS/EE.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - New Grad
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is hiring new grad ML engineers to build intelligent cloud services. Work on ML-powered database optimization, automated resource management, and predictive analytics at scale. Requirements: BS/MS in CS, experience with ML frameworks, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer - Entry Level
jobs.description: Join Indeed's ML team to help millions find jobs! Build recommendation systems, search ranking models, and NLP systems. Great for entry-level candidates with ML internship experience. We value learning and growth. Requirements: Python, ML fundamentals, SQL, passion for helping people.

jobs.title: Associate Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Build ML models for fraud detection, customer behavior prediction, and algorithmic trading support. Entry-level position with mentorship from senior ML engineers. Requirements: BS in CS/Statistics/Math, Python, Scikit-learn, understanding of ML algorithms, financial interest a plus.

jobs.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Help optimize flight operations using ML! Build predictive models for flight delays, crew scheduling, and customer service optimization. Entry-level friendly with strong training program. Requirements: BS in relevant field, Python, R or Python ML libraries, strong problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: ML Engineer I
jobs.description: AT&T's AI/ML team is expanding! Work on network optimization, customer analytics, and 5G AI applications. Entry-level role with clear growth path. Requirements: BS/MS in CS/EE, Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, understanding of neural networks, telecommunications interest helpful.

jobs.title: Entry Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: Develop AI solutions for smart printing, predictive maintenance, and customer support automation. Perfect for new grads interested in applying ML to hardware/software integration. Requirements: BS in CS/CE, Python, ML frameworks, image processing knowledge a plus.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Graduate Program
jobs.location: Dallas, TX (with travel to McLean, VA)
jobs.description: Join Capital One's ML Rotational Program! 2-year program rotating through different ML teams (fraud detection, credit risk, marketing optimization). Excellent for recent graduates. Requirements: BS/MS in CS/DS/related, Python, ML fundamentals, AWS knowledge helpful.

jobs.title: Associate ML Engineer
jobs.description: Build ML models for revenue management, customer personalization, and operational efficiency. Entry-level position with mentorship and training. Southwest's collaborative culture perfect for learning. Requirements: BS in quantitative field, Python, SQL, basic ML knowledge, strong communication skills.

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
jobs.description: Support military families with ML-powered financial services! Build models for fraud detection, insurance claims processing, and customer insights. Entry-level with strong benefits and work-life balance. Requirements: BS in relevant field, Python, Scikit-learn or similar, passion for serving military community.

jobs.title: ML Engineer - Early Career
jobs.description: Develop ML algorithms for semiconductor design automation, quality control, and predictive maintenance. Unique opportunity to apply ML to hardware engineering. Requirements: BS/MS in CS/EE, Python, C++, understanding of ML algorithms, signal processing knowledge a plus.

jobs.title: Entry Level Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Apply ML to aerospace and defense applications. Work on computer vision for autonomous systems, predictive maintenance, and data analytics. Security clearance sponsored. Requirements: US Citizenship required, BS/MS in CS/EE, Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, strong academic record.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - New Graduate
jobs.description: Build ML solutions for test and measurement systems. Work on signal processing, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics for engineering systems. Great for new grads interested in applying ML to instrumentation. Requirements: BS/MS in relevant field, Python, MATLAB, ML fundamentals.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer - Entry Level
jobs.description: Help build AI/ML solutions for cloud infrastructure management. Work on automated resource optimization, anomaly detection, and predictive scaling. Entry-level with mentorship program. Requirements: BS in CS, Python, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), basic ML knowledge.
